usability_issues.title: Empty Ticker Not Handled Gracefully
usability_issues.description: When user clears ticker input, app should show friendly message
usability_issues.suggested_fix: Add validation: if not ticker or not ticker.strip(): show helpful message

usability_issues.title: DCF Shows Negative/Zero Fair Value
usability_issues.description: Users may be confused by $0 fair value - needs better error message
usability_issues.suggested_fix: Show clear message: 'Cannot calculate DCF - insufficient financial data'

usability_issues.title: Missing Key Technical Indicators
usability_issues.suggested_fix: Ensure all standard indicators are calculated

usability_issues.title: Tab Names Not User-Friendly
usability_issues.description: Tab names use technical jargon - 'DD' (Due Diligence) may not be clear to beginners
usability_issues.suggested_fix: Consider renaming to 'Valuation Analysis' or add tooltips explaining 'DD'

usability_issues.title: No Loading Indicators for Slow Operations
usability_issues.description: Monte Carlo with 10,000 simulations has no progress bar

usability_issues.title: Error Messages Not User-Friendly
usability_issues.description: Technical error messages (e.g., 'KeyError: history') shown to users
usability_issues.suggested_fix: Wrap technical errors in friendly messages: 'Unable to load data. Please try again.'

usability_issues.title: Not Mobile Optimized
usability_issues.description: Streamlit's wide layout doesn't work well on mobile - charts overflow
usability_issues.suggested_fix: Test on mobile devices, consider responsive chart sizing

bugs.title: Invalid Ticker Not Detected
bugs.description: Ticker 'INVALID123' should be rejected but wasn't
bugs.suggested_fix: Add ticker format validation before API call

bugs.title: No Handling for After-Hours Trading
bugs.description: App doesn't distinguish between market hours and after-hours prices

bugs.title: Stale Data Not Detected
bugs.description: If API fails, cached data shown without warning
bugs.suggested_fix: Check data freshness, show warning if >1 hour old

enhancements.title: Add Keyboard Shortcuts
enhancements.description: Power users would benefit from keyboard navigation (e.g., 1-6 for tab switching)
enhancements.severity: Consider adding: st.markdown with custom JS for keyboard shortcuts

enhancements.title: Add 'Favorites' or 'Watchlist' Feature
enhancements.description: Users have to re-type tickers frequently - watchlist would improve workflow
enhancements.severity: Add session state watchlist with quick-select dropdown

enhancements.title: Add Data Freshness Indicator
enhancements.description: Users don't know when data was last updated - show timestamp
enhancements.severity: Display 'Last updated: X minutes ago' with cache TTL info

enhancements.title: Export Feature Missing
enhancements.description: Users cannot export charts, valuations, or reports
enhancements.severity: Add 'Export to CSV/PDF' buttons for key analyses

enhancements.title: No Lazy Loading for Large Datasets
enhancements.description: All data loaded at once - should paginate or lazy load
enhancements.suggested_fix: Implement pagination for large tables (>100 rows)

enhancements.title: Heavy Calculations Block UI
enhancements.description: Monte Carlo with 10K simulations freezes the app
enhancements.suggested_fix: Move heavy calculations to background threads or add async processing

enhancements.title: No Alt Text for Charts
enhancements.description: Screen readers cannot describe plotly charts
enhancements.suggested_fix: Add descriptive labels and aria-labels to all charts

enhancements.title: Insufficient Color Contrast
enhancements.description: Some text may not meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards
enhancements.suggested_fix: Audit color palette for 4.5:1 contrast ratio

enhancements.title: No Keyboard Navigation Support
enhancements.description: Tab navigation doesn't work consistently across all widgets
enhancements.suggested_fix: Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible
